name: PV_BinBufRd
description: Read FFT data from a buffer, scrubbing through stored frames at a normalised position. Reads from a buffer prepared by PV_RecordBuf and writes the bins back into the active FFT chain. Supports per-bin selection (binStart/binSkip/numBins) for partial reading. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: Active FFT chain buffer (output of FFT)

inputs.name: playbuf
inputs.description: Buffer holding recorded FFT frames (from PV_RecordBuf)

inputs.name: clear
inputs.description: If non-zero, clear bins not selected by binStart/binSkip/numBins

name: PV_BinDelay
description: Per-bin spectral delay line. Each FFT bin is independently delayed up to maxdelay seconds with feedback, using companion delay/feedback buffers to store state across frames. Useful for spectral smearing and frequency-dependent echo effects. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: maxdelay
inputs.description: Maximum delay per bin in seconds

inputs.name: hop
inputs.description: FFT hop size as a fraction of the FFT size

name: PV_BinFilter
description: Pass only a contiguous range of FFT bins, zeroing the rest. Acts as a brick-wall spectral band-pass selecting bins from `start` (inclusive) up to `end` (inclusive). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_BinPlayBuf
description: Play stored FFT frames at a variable rate, optionally selecting a subset of bins. Reads from a buffer recorded by PV_RecordBuf, advancing through frames at `rate` (negative = reverse, fractional = time-stretch) and copying the chosen bins into the active FFT chain. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Start offset into the recorded frames, 0..1

inputs.name: clear
inputs.description: If non-zero, clear bins outside the selected range

name: PV_BufRd
description: Scrub through FFT frames stored in a buffer. Reads the frame at the normalised position `point` and writes it into the active FFT chain. Same idea as PV_BinPlayBuf but reads all bins and is positioned by point rather than rate. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_EvenBin
description: Pass only the even-numbered FFT bins, zeroing odd bins. Produces a comb-filtered spectrum. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_OddBin
description: Pass only the odd-numbered FFT bins, zeroing even bins. Produces a comb-filtered spectrum complementary to PV_EvenBin. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_Freeze
description: Freeze the current FFT frame when `freeze` is positive, holding the spectrum until released. Releases (passes input through) when freeze is non-positive. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: freeze
inputs.description: Freeze the current spectrum if > 0; otherwise pass input through

name: PV_FreqBuffer
description: Per-bin frequency offset using values from a control buffer. Each bin's frequency is offset by the corresponding sample in the data buffer, allowing arbitrary spectral re-tuning curves. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_Invert
description: Invert the FFT magnitudes — quiet bins become loud and loud bins become quiet — within the dynamic range of the current frame. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_MagBuffer
description: Per-bin magnitude scaling using values from a control buffer. Each bin's magnitude is multiplied by the corresponding sample in the data buffer, useful for arbitrary spectral envelopes. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_MagMap
description: Map the FFT magnitudes through a transfer function stored in a buffer (waveshaping in the magnitude domain). The current magnitude indexes the map buffer to produce the new magnitude. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: mapbuf
inputs.description: Buffer holding the magnitude transfer curve

name: PV_MaxMagN
description: Keep the N bins with the largest magnitudes, zero the rest. Produces a sparse spectrum containing only the loudest partials. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numbins
inputs.description: Number of largest-magnitude bins to retain

name: PV_MinMagN
description: Keep the N bins with the smallest magnitudes, zero the rest. Inverse of PV_MaxMagN — produces a sparse residual spectrum. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numbins
inputs.description: Number of smallest-magnitude bins to retain

name: PV_NoiseSynthF
description: Spectral noise resynthesis (frame-stable variant). Replaces partials whose magnitudes fall below `threshold` with band-limited noise, preserving the noise-like residual after partial-tracking. The F variant uses a deterministic seed per frame. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold below which bins are treated as noise

inputs.name: numFrames
inputs.description: Frames to accumulate before resynthesis starts

name: PV_NoiseSynthP
description: Spectral noise resynthesis (per-frame variant). Replaces partials whose magnitudes fall below `threshold` with band-limited noise. The P variant re-randomises noise phases each frame for a more stochastic texture. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold below which bins are treated as noise

inputs.name: numFrames
inputs.description: Frames to accumulate before resynthesis starts

name: PV_PartialSynthF
description: Spectral partial resynthesis (frame-stable variant). Keeps only the partials whose magnitudes are above `threshold`, suppressing the noise residual. Companion to PV_NoiseSynthF. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold above which bins are kept as partials

inputs.name: numFrames
inputs.description: Frames to accumulate before resynthesis starts

name: PV_PartialSynthP
description: Spectral partial resynthesis (per-frame variant). Keeps only the partials whose magnitudes are above `threshold`, suppressing the noise residual. The P variant re-randomises phases per frame. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold above which bins are kept as partials

inputs.name: numFrames
inputs.description: Frames to accumulate before resynthesis starts

name: PV_PitchShift
description: Bin-shift pitch shifter operating in the spectral domain. Multiplies bin frequencies by `ratio` to transpose the spectrum without time-stretching. Note: the source comments call this implementation rough — use with caution. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_PlayBuf
description: Play stored FFT frames at a variable rate. Reads frames recorded by PV_RecordBuf and writes them into the active FFT chain, advancing at `rate` (negative = reverse, fractional = time-stretch). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PV_RecordBuf
description: Record the active FFT chain into a buffer for later playback by PV_PlayBuf, PV_BinPlayBuf, PV_BufRd or PV_BinBufRd. Use SimpleNumber.calcPVRecSize on the client to compute the required buffer size. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Wrap recording when reaching the end if non-zero

inputs.name: hop
inputs.description: FFT hop size as a fraction of the FFT size

inputs.name: wintype
inputs.description: Window type used by the FFT chain (0=Sine, 1=Hann, -1=Rect)

name: PV_SpectralEnhance
description: Strengthen harmonic structure by emphasising bins at integer multiples of detected partials. Picks `numPartials` candidate fundamentals, raises bins at `ratio` multiples, and mixes the result back at `strength`. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numPartials
inputs.description: Number of candidate partials to emphasise

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: Harmonic ratio used when emphasising (e.g. 2 = octaves)

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Mix strength of the enhanced bins, 0..1

name: PV_SpectralMap
description: Cross-synthesis-style spectral mapping. Combines the active FFT chain with an analysed spectrum stored in `specBuffer`, optionally normalising and freezing the source spectrum. `mode` selects the combination rule (multiply, add, subtract …). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: specBuffer
inputs.description: Buffer of the second analysed spectrum

inputs.name: floor
inputs.description: Magnitude floor applied to the result

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Apply a smoothing window to the source spectrum

name: PVInfo
description: Read magnitude and frequency of a single bin from a PV-format buffer (offline FFT analysis stored in a buffer). Multi-output: [magnitude, frequency]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: pvbuffer
inputs.description: PV-format buffer containing offline FFT data

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Pointer/offset within the PV buffer (frame index)

name: PVSynth
description: Resynthesise an offline PV-format buffer back to audio by selecting a subset of bins. Read all or a slice of bins (binStart/binSkip/numBins) from the recorded spectrum, allowing partial reconstruction and frequency scaling. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: pvbuffer
inputs.description: PV-format buffer containing offline FFT data

inputs.name: numBins
inputs.description: Number of bins to read (0 = all)

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Pointer/offset within the PV buffer (frame index)

inputs.name: freqMul
inputs.description: Multiply bin frequencies by this factor

inputs.name: freqAdd
inputs.description: Add this value to bin frequencies

name: BinData
description: Read frequency and magnitude of a single FFT bin from the active FFT chain. Multi-output: [magnitude, frequency]. The `overlaps` input must match the FFT hop fraction so internal scaling is correct. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: overlaps
inputs.description: FFT overlap fraction (must match the FFT hop)

name: AtsSynth
description: ATS (Analysis-Transformation-Synthesis) deterministic resynthesis. Reads partials from an ATS buffer and resynthesises them additively. ATS data is the deterministic + stochastic decomposition by Pampin/Di Liscia/Beyls; loaded from .ats files via the AtsFile class on the client. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numPartials
inputs.description: Number of partials to synthesise (0 = all)

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer (0..numFrames-1)

inputs.name: freqMul
inputs.description: Multiply partial frequencies by this factor

inputs.name: freqAdd
inputs.description: Add this value to partial frequencies

name: AtsNoiSynth
description: ATS resynthesis with both deterministic (sinusoidal) partials and stochastic (band-limited noise) bands. Mixes the two components by `sinePct` and `noisePct`. Requires an ATS file containing residual noise data (atsType >= 3). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numPartials
inputs.description: Number of partials to synthesise (0 = all)

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

inputs.name: freqMul
inputs.description: Multiply partial frequencies by this factor

inputs.name: freqAdd
inputs.description: Add this value to partial frequencies

name: AtsPartial
description: Synthesise a single ATS partial. Useful for reconstructing one analysed partial in isolation, or driving multiple AtsPartial UGens with different transformations per partial. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

inputs.name: freqMul
inputs.description: Multiply partial frequency by this factor

inputs.name: freqAdd
inputs.description: Add this value to partial frequency

name: AtsBand
description: Synthesise a single ATS noise band as audio. Useful for granular access to the residual stochastic component. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

name: AtsFreq
description: Read the analysed frequency of a single ATS partial as a control signal. Useful for driving other UGens with the analysed frequency envelope. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

name: AtsAmp
description: Read the analysed amplitude of a single ATS partial as a control signal. Useful for driving other UGens with the analysed amplitude envelope. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

name: AtsNoise
description: Read the analysed amplitude of a single ATS noise band as a control signal. Useful for driving custom noise synthesis with the analysed envelope. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

name: AtsParInfo
description: Read amplitude and frequency of a single ATS partial as a multi-output control signal. Multi-output: [amplitude, frequency]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: filePointer
inputs.description: Frame index into the ATS buffer

name: AtsFile
description: Client-side helper (not a server UGen) for loading ATS analysis files. Parses the .ats binary header (sample rate, frame size, partial count, atsType) and writes the data into a server buffer for use by AtsSynth/AtsNoiSynth/AtsPartial/AtsBand/AtsFreq/AtsAmp/AtsNoise/AtsParInfo. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: .load(path)
inputs.description: Read the .ats file at `path`, allocate a server buffer and load the data into it

inputs.name: .load_to_buffer(buffer)
inputs.description: Load into a pre-allocated buffer (alias for .load(buffer))

inputs.name: .buffer
inputs.description: Return the server bufnum to pass to ATS UGens

inputs.name: .free_buffer
inputs.description: Free the server buffer holding the analysis data

unavailable_reason: Client-side data/helper class; no scsynth UGen is emitted.

name: LPCSynth
description: Linear Predictive Coding resynthesis. Excites an LPC filter (whose coefficients are stored in `buffer`) with `signal` and reads through the analysis frames at the normalised position `pointer`. Use as the resynthesis side of an LPC analysis/resynthesis pair (cross-synthesis vocoder). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: Buffer holding LPC analysis frames (poles + residuals)

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: Excitation signal to drive the LPC filter

inputs.name: pointer
inputs.description: Position to read from analysis frames, 0.0..1.0

name: LPCVals
description: Read residual amplitude, original RMS and pitch from an LPC analysis buffer at a given position. Multi-output: [residual_amp, orig_rms, pitch]. Use to drive a custom excitation in place of the standard LPCSynth excitation. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: pointer
inputs.description: Position to read from analysis frames, 0.0..1.0

name: BFEncode1
description: First-order B-format encoder (Furse-Malham). Pans a mono input to four B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z] using azimuth, elevation and distance (rho). `wComp=1` enables the W-compensation that scales W with distance. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: rho
inputs.description: Distance scaling factor (1 = on the unit circle)

name: BFEncode2
description: First-order B-format encoder using Cartesian coordinates (point_x, point_y, elevation). Pans a mono input to four B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: BFEncodeSter
description: First-order B-format encoder for a stereo source. Pans a stereo pair to four B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z] with a `width` controlling the angular separation between the two virtual sources. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: BFDecode1
description: First-order B-format decoder for a single virtual loudspeaker. Decodes a B-format signal [W, X, Y, Z] to one channel at the given azimuth/elevation. To produce a multi-speaker rig, instantiate one BFDecode1 per speaker. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: BFManipulate
description: Apply rotate / tilt / tumble transformations to a first-order B-format signal in one UGen. Outputs the transformed [W, X, Y, Z]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: Rotation around the Z axis in radians

inputs.name: tilt
inputs.description: Tilt around the X axis in radians

inputs.name: tumble
inputs.description: Tumble around the Y axis in radians

name: Rotate
description: Rotate a first-order B-format signal around the Z axis. Equivalent to applying Rotate2 to (X, Y) while leaving W and Z unchanged. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.
unavailable_reason: Confirmed sclang-side pseudo-UGen; unavailable until a VibeLang lowering is implemented.

name: Tilt
description: Tilt a first-order B-format signal around the X axis. Rotates (X, Z) while leaving W and Y unchanged. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.
unavailable_reason: Confirmed sclang-side pseudo-UGen; unavailable until a VibeLang lowering is implemented.

name: Tumble
description: Tumble a first-order B-format signal around the Y axis. Rotates (Y, Z) while leaving W and X unchanged. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.
unavailable_reason: Confirmed sclang-side pseudo-UGen; unavailable until a VibeLang lowering is implemented.

name: FMHEncode0
description: Second-order Furse-Malham B-format encoder using azimuth/elevation. Pans a mono input to nine B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z, R, S, T, U, V] (first + second order). Variant 0: ignores `rho`/`wComp`. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: FMHEncode1
description: Second-order Furse-Malham B-format encoder using azimuth/elevation/distance. Pans a mono input to nine B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z, R, S, T, U, V]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: FMHEncode2
description: Second-order Furse-Malham B-format encoder using Cartesian coordinates. Pans a mono input to nine B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z, R, S, T, U, V]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: FMHDecode1
description: Second-order Furse-Malham B-format decoder for a single virtual loudspeaker. Decodes nine B-format channels [W, X, Y, Z, R, S, T, U, V] to one speaker at the given azimuth/elevation. The .stereo / .square / .quad / .pentagon / .hexagon / .octagon1 / .octagon2 / .cube / .doubleHex / .dodecahedron class methods are convenience constructors that emit the right speaker rig. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: A2B
description: Convert an A-format (tetrahedral) signal [a, b, c, d] to first-order B-format [W, X, Y, Z]. The standard tetrahedral microphone capsule layout: a=front-left-up, b=front-right-down, c=back-left-down, d=back-right-up. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: B2A
description: Convert a first-order B-format signal [W, X, Y, Z] to A-format [a, b, c, d] (tetrahedral capsule layout). Inverse of A2B. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: B2Ster
description: Decode the horizontal portion (W, X, Y) of a first-order B-format signal to stereo. Convenience downmix for previewing B-format material on a stereo system. Outputs [left, right]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: B2UHJ
description: Encode the horizontal portion (W, X, Y) of a first-order B-format signal to two-channel UHJ — a stereo-compatible matrix that retains directional cues. Outputs [left, right]. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: UHJ2B
description: Decode a two-channel UHJ signal back to the horizontal B-format components [W, X, Y]. Inverse of B2UHJ. The Z channel is not recoverable from UHJ. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: Balance
description: Apply the RMS amplitude of `test` to `in`, like a sidechain gain follower. The high-pass corner `hp` removes DC bias before measuring the RMS. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Signal whose amplitude will be modulated

inputs.name: test
inputs.description: Signal whose RMS amplitude is measured and applied to `in`

inputs.name: hp
inputs.description: High-pass cutoff (Hz) applied before measuring RMS

inputs.name: stor
inputs.description: Storage flag for the internal RMS buffer

name: Maxamp
description: Track the running maximum absolute amplitude of the input over the last `numSamps` samples. Useful for VU-style metering or normalisation analysis. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: Metro
description: Trigger source emitting impulses at `bpm` for `numBeats` beats then stopping. Single-shot metronome — to repeat, retrigger from outside. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numBeats
inputs.description: Number of beats to emit before stopping

name: MoogVCF
description: Moog ladder VCF emulation. Four-pole low-pass filter with self-oscillating resonance modelled on the classic Moog voltage-controlled filter. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PanX
description: Multichannel circular panner. Spreads a mono input across `numChans` equally-spaced output channels at angular position `pos` with `width` controlling the angular extent. Multi-output: numChans channels (default 4). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PanX2D
description: Two-dimensional grid panner — composes PanX along X and Y to spread a mono input across a numChansX × numChansY speaker grid. Multi-output: numChansX × numChansY channels (default 4×4 = 16). From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.
unavailable_reason: Confirmed sclang-side pseudo-UGen; unavailable until a VibeLang lowering is implemented.

name: PermMod
description: Permutation-style frequency modulator. Modulates the input by a single carrier of frequency `freq` using a permutation algorithm that produces non-standard FM sidebands. Audio-rate only; the input must also be audio rate. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: PermModT
description: Tendency-style permutation modulator. Modulates the input with permutation FM whose effective frequency wanders between `outfreq` and `infreq`, producing a constantly-shifting timbre. Audio-rate only. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: outfreq
inputs.description: Lower frequency bound for the modulator

inputs.name: infreq
inputs.description: Upper frequency bound for the modulator

name: PermModArray
description: Array-driven permutation modulator. Like PermMod but takes an array of pattern values that are appended to the inputs at instantiation time, controlling which permutation samples are used. Audio-rate only. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: First entry of the permutation pattern (additional pattern entries are passed positionally)

name: AudioMSG
description: Audio waveshaper implementing Modified-Sine-Generation: returns sin((in*0.5pi) + sin(in*2pi*index)). Functions as a phase-distortion oscillator/waveshaper hybrid. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Modulation index in radians (default 0; pi = strong)

name: CombLP
description: Comb filter with a one-pole low-pass in the feedback loop. Combines the periodic resonance of a comb with progressive high-frequency damping for a more natural decay. `gate` opens/closes excitation injection. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: maxdelaytime
inputs.description: Maximum delay time in seconds (allocates the buffer)

inputs.name: coef
inputs.description: Low-pass coefficient inside the feedback loop, 0..1

name: PosRatio
description: Returns the ratio of positive samples within a window of `1/period` seconds. Useful as a cheap DC/asymmetry detector. `thresh` sets the minimum amplitude to count. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: period
inputs.description: Polling period in Hz (window is 1/period seconds)

inputs.name: thresh
inputs.description: Minimum absolute amplitude to count a sample

name: SinTone
description: Sinusoidal oscillator computed by a real sin() call rather than a wavetable lookup. Higher CPU than SinOsc but no table-quantisation error. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

name: TTendency
description: Tendency-mask random source. On each trigger, draws a random value within a tendency mask defined by parX/parY/parA/parB using one of 16 distributions selected by `dist`. Distribution codes: 0=uniform, 1=lowpass, 2=highpass, 3=mean, 4=beta, 5=cauchy, 6=gauss, 7=poisson, 8=expRand, 9=exponential, 10=gamma, 11=laplace, 12=alaplace, 13=hcos, 14=logistic, 15=arcsin. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Trigger — draws a new value on positive transitions

inputs.name: parX
inputs.description: Lower bound or distribution parameter X

inputs.name: parY
inputs.description: Upper bound or distribution parameter Y

name: WarpZ
description: Granular time-stretch / pitch-shift with optional zero-crossing search. Reads a buffer at `pointer` (0..1), splitting playback into `overlaps` overlapping windows of `windowSize` seconds; `freqScale` transposes; `windowRandRatio` jitters window length. `zeroSearch`/`zeroStart` snap window boundaries to zero crossings to avoid clicks. Multi-output: numChannels channels. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: numChannels
inputs.description: Number of output channels (must match buffer's channel count)

inputs.name: zeroSearch
inputs.description: Search ahead this many samples for a zero crossing at window end

inputs.name: zeroStart
inputs.description: Search ahead this many samples for a zero crossing at window start
